# Erika Wescott

> Erika Wescott is a performance and nutrition coach who helps ambitious professionals build real strength, steady energy, and habits that actually last. Evidence-based, no-bullshit coaching with zero fads or restriction.

## Ways to work with her
- **1:1 Performance & Nutrition Coaching** — Personalized strength training and nutrition coaching built around real life, not extremes. For people who want results without burnout, crash diets, or influencer gimmicks.

## Approach
Lift heavy. Eat real food. Feel good. Sustainable coaching for busy professionals who are done with quick fixes and want a stronger, more capable body for the long run.

## Areas of expertise
Strength training, Nutrition coaching, Habit change, Performance coaching, Fat loss, Sustainable lifestyle change.
